name: Sunny Days Summer Camp
street_address: St. Katharine Drexel Catholic School, 1053 Holland Road
description_short: Small weekly day camp on the grounds of St. Katharine Drexel Catholic School for children who have finished Pre-K3 through 3rd grade. Groups rotate through crafts, science, sports, yoga, cooking and water play, with a special event every Friday.

sessions.name: Week 2 (4 days, runs only with enough campers)

notes: 2026: June 22 to August 7, closed July 3; the June 29 to July 2 week runs only with enough enrollment and its price is not shown for 2026. Full day 9 am to 3 pm $250 a week; mini camp 9 am to noon $150 a week; 10% sibling discount. CARES 8 to 9 am and 3 to 4 pm at $10 an hour. Bring lunch and snack. Adventure Camp for children who finished grades 4 to 6 runs alongside ($310 for 5 days, $260 for 3). Registration for 2026 is closed. The mailing address is Southampton; the camp describes its location as Holland.
